item_short_desc: Rothco’s Brass Ribbon Mount offers a dependable solution for securing ribbons and medals to uniforms or display cases. Crafted from durable and lightweight brass, this ribbon mount ensures long-lasting use while maintaining a polished appearance. The straight pin with a clutch back allows for easy attachment and removal, making it a practical choice for uniforms, awards, or decorative displays. Designed with precision, this mount provides a secure fit without compromising on style.
